name: Rapid-MLX
description: Rapid-MLX is an open-source (Apache 2.0) OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM inference server and Mac app for Apple Silicon, built on MLX, focused on reliable tool calling for coding agents. Release-gated with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Aider, Hermes and DeepSeek Harness.
summaryZh: Rapid-MLX is an open-source (Apache 2.0) OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM inference server and Mac app for Apple Silicon, built on MLX, focused on reliable tool calling for coding agents. Release-gated with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Aider, Hermes and DeepSeek Harness. 这类项目更偏执行与编排，适合搭自动化工作流或多代理系统。
whyItMatters: 最近仍在高频更新，仓库成熟度和社区基础都不错。
fitFor: 适合做推理服务、模型部署、性能优化的工程团队。
